summary: The synchronous reset uses the opposite polarity from the testbench.
reasoning: The testbench expects count to become zero when rst is high on the first clock edge (tb/counter_tb.v:8-14, 21), but the RTL resets only when rst is low (rtl/counter.v:3). This explains the first-cycle unknown count; the baseline compiles and synthesizes, so the observed issue is behavioral. No independent validation of the proposed change is available.
